mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.age AS age, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, sc.score FROM student s INNER JOIN sc ON s.id = sc.student_id INNER JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id ORDER BY s.id, c.id

SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.age AS age, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, sc.score FROM student s INNER JOIN sc ON s.id = sc.student_id INNER JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE s.name = #{studentName} ORDER BY c.name

SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.age AS age, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, sc.score FROM student s INNER JOIN sc ON s.id = sc.student_id INNER JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '数学' AND sc.score > #{score} ORDER BY sc.score DESC
